ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio; surface is approximately 94% low-intensity (black/dark gray) with ~6% high-intensity (white/light gray) localized features.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation across the entire contiguous surface area; high-contrast white pixels are localized in small circular annular clusters (scars) and dense concentrations at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped indentation; interior angle is approximately 45 degrees relative to the vertical axis of the peduncle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular macro-serrations (peaks) present on the left lobe trailing edge; the right lobe trailing edge displays lower-amplitude, more uniform serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature following the trailing edge from the notch to the distal tips; outer leading edges exhibit convex curvature.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and ring-shaped high-contrast white pixel clusters (diameter range 2-12 pixels) distributed across both lobes, likely corresponding to barnacle attachment points or scars.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense calcified barnacle colonization on the distal tips of both lobes; significant irregular material loss/jaggedness on the left lobe trailing edge suggesting mechanical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Asymmetrical trailing edge profile where the left lobe is substantially more jagged and irregular than the right lobe.
